source: Opricovic & Tzeng 2004, European Journal of Operational Research 156(2):445-455, doi:10.1016/S0377-2217(03)00020-1, Tables 1-2 (input, problems f and phi), Table 3 (VIKOR S, R, Q), Section 5 (compromise A2)
note: Table 3 prints the unweighted normalized distances d1j, d2j (0, 0.25, 1 and 1, 0.5, 0); our weighted distances are w = 0.5 times these. Problem phi (phi1 = f1 + 5, phi2 = f2 / 1000 - 1) must give identical S, R, Q (Section 5). The paper's step (d) says 'decreasing order', a misprint: the text and Table 3 rank by minimum Q.
